title: Hold a driller's licence
what: Drill water bores on land the business does not own or occupy only under a driller's licence covering that type of work.

sources.title: Water Act 1912 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry out any work as a driller on any land (other than land of which the person is the owner or occupier) unless: (a) the person is the holder of a driller's licence issued by the Ministerial Corporation, and (b) the work being carried out is of a type or class prescribed in the regulations and set out in the licence issued to that person

sources.title: Water Act 1912 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 4, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: Ministerial Corporation means the Water Administration Ministerial Corporation constituted by the Water Administration Act 1986.

reach.condition: if it drills water bores on land it does not own or occupy
